headline: OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman called Elon Musk a bully who respects only people who hit back, while saying he will still work with him.
score_reason: Pool score kept: an on-record quote by a chief executive, matched to the interview transcript; it is personal sparring, not a business or policy change.
importance_line: It shows a public feud between two of the industry's best-known leaders even as their companies sign self-imposed safety pledges, which matters to people hoping rival labs will coordinate on safety, but it is personal sparring in an interview and changes no policy.
summary: Vanity Fair reports, in an interview published on 5 Oct, that OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman called Elon Musk, of the rival AI company SpaceXAI, a bully who respects only people who hit back, but said "I will work with Elon, of course". Business Insider, which also wrote up the interview, notes that Musk has called Altman "Scam Altman" and that the exchange comes after leaders of OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceXAI, Google and Nvidia signed a White House-driven agreement on self-imposed safety steps.
notes: Pool item is Business Insider's write-up of the Vanity Fair interview; the interview (Part 1) was read and the quote matches, so Vanity Fair is credited and linked as the first reporter. The 'Scam Altman' name-calling and the White House agreement detail come from Business Insider only. Same interview as C05-04.
